name: SaveState_ReadRecordPayload
bounded_source_shapes: Direct aggregate assignment, scalar fields, local nonvolatile pointer, and nonvolatile DMA-view forms all remain 72/72 bytes with 8 differing halfwords: GCC emits three scalar stores.
A post-incremented volatile DMA-word view remains 72/72 bytes with 8 differing halfwords. It emits two one-register STMIA stores and one scalar store, not the reference three-register transfer.
A static inline aggregate-by-value writer emits the requested LDMIA/STMIA pair, but constructs the compound descriptor on the stack: 84/72 bytes, 41 differing halfwords, and 30 wrong instructions.
Static inline scalar and four-argument writers remain 72/72 bytes but regress to 19 differing halfwords and 28 wrong instructions; the inlined stores remain scalar.
A register aggregate plus an inline writer introduces two stack copies: 92/72 bytes, 45 differing halfwords, and 34 wrong instructions.
remaining: The reference publishes the three-word DMA command through a standalone three-register STMIA with base restoration. Canonical GCC 2.96 Thumb lowering emits single-register moves or, for a 12-byte memory copy, an immediately paired LDMIA/STMIA block copy. No tested ordinary-C lifetime or aggregate shape emits the standalone transfer.
notes: All measurements compiled the complete declared save-state reconstruction composition once; existing exact owners remained exact under the canonical route.
The assembly classifier confirms this owner as thumb_multiple_transfer_module (1 owner, 72 bytes).
No inline assembly, fixed-register variable, compiler barrier, ABI escape, copied instruction bytes, compiler modification, or per-owner production flag override was used.
